notes.title: Dragons Brew Alpha 0.2.2.0 Patch Notes
notes.content: [p][b]Main Features[/b]  [/p][p][/p][list][*][p]The crafting system has been fully updated to improve usability, responsiveness, and reliability.[/p][/*][*][p]A sprint function has been added, allowing the player to move faster across towns and the cafe.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Minor Features & Changes[/b][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Town NPCs and customers now have proper colliders to improve interactions and movement.[/p][/*][*][p]Time is now paused when using the crafter UI.[/p][/*][*][p]Menu negative prices are now displayed in red for better clarity.[/p][/*][*][p]Heart particles have been added when petting Willow, Bean, and Niki.[/p][/*][*][p]Bed interactions have been updated from a context popup to a highlight system for consistency with other interactables.[/p][/*][*][p]DM tutorial boxes now automatically open on first playthrough and pause time while displayed.[/p][/*][*][p]New control tooltip popups have been added to help players with gameplay mechanics, which can be disabled in options.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Balancing[/b][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Player movement has been slightly slowed to accommodate the new sprint function.[/p][/*][*][p]Macaron Shells, Puff Pasties, and Waffle Cones now sell for 0 to better balance cafe income.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where the crafting system could get stuck by overhauling the crafting mechanics entirely.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where customer sound effects could continue playing on a new day even when no customers were present.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where customers could get stuck at the front of the queue by adding a constant update to send customers home once their order is fulfilled (unless they are gaming), ensuring they always leave the queue [i](fourth time’s the charm!)[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you for your continued feedback - your reports are helping to shape a stronger experience with every update.[/p]

notes.title: Dragons Brew Alpha 0.2.1.2 Patch Notes
notes.content: [p][b]Minor Features & Changes[/b][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]A sound effect has been added when interacting with post boxes.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Fixed the bug where a customer could become stuck at the front of the queue (third time lucky!).[/p][/*][*][p]The craft button now locks instantly after crafting to prevent double-clicking and accidentally losing extra ingredients.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Dragons Brew Alpha 0.2.1.1 Patch Notes
notes.content: [p][b]Minor Features & Changes[/b][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Waffle Cones have been added to the Harbour Market to circumvent Panini Press crafting.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Fixed the "Complete a miniquest" main quest bug.[/p][/*][*][p]The crafting system and UI have been fixed and are now more intuitive and responsive.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the "kerching" sound effect could still play even when a customer was not ordering.[/p][/*][*][p]The queue system has been refactored, and the bug where a customer could sometimes get stuck at the front of the queue has been fixed [i](second time lucky!)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the spacebar “interact” function not working by adding a fallback option as a temporary solution [i](the input system will be fully reviewed in version 0.3)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved issues with floating items and full item stacking by updating the way item stacks merge.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Dragons Brew Alpha 0.2.1.0 Patch Notes
notes.content: [p][b]Minor Features & Changes[/b][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]The name and café name character limit has been increased from 15 to 18 characters.[/p][/*][*][p]A new HUD button has been added to allow you to show or hide quests for a cleaner interface.[/p][/*][*][p]The furniture placement preview opacity has been increased from 50% to 80% to improve visibility during placement.[/p][/*][*][p]The café shop front sign now dynamically updates to reflect the current global lighting, improving overall visual cohesion.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where players could not build in property extensions after reloading a save.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an interaction bug in Willow’s Wand – Willow has now been relocated to her cat bed for now to prevent issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed interaction issues with the coffee machine and boardgame shelf that opened both UI panels simultaneously.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Dragons Brew Alpha 0.2.0.0 Patch Notes
notes.content: [p][b]Main Features[/b]  [/p][p][/p][list][*][p]A new Bus Transport System has been added, allowing players to travel between the towns Pebblebrook and Thistledown[/p][/*][*][p]Thistledown Town has been added, introducing a new region with unique charm and atmosphere.[/p][/*][*][p]New shops are now available in Thistledown, including Socket and Spanner, Eccentric Essentials, and Hometown Roasters, each offering exclusive items, decor, and furniture sets.[/p][/*][*][p]Pebblebrook and existing shop interiors have received a full artwork and tilemap overhaul for improved visual clarity and polish.[/p][/*][*][p]Seasonal visual changes have been introduced across all buildings and the HUD.[/p][/*][*][p]A new appliance system has been added, introducing a more modular and upgradeable approach to crafting stations.[/p][/*][*][p]A new recipe unlock system has added to work alongside the boardgame unlock system, providing a more intuitive and structured way to unlock recipes.[/p][/*][*][p]Thistledown and Pebblebrook now feature basic maps in the player UI for easier navigation.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Minor Features & Changes[/b][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Quest pointers have been added to guide players to objective locations.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now pin recipes to the HUD for quick reference.[/p][/*][*][p]Helpful tips have been added to quests, viewable from the HUD quest board.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now bulk buy items in the Harbour Market for convenience.[/p][/*][*][p]Kitchen and garden storage chests have been added to help with inventory space.[/p][/*][*][p]Mouse-based toolbar selection has been implemented, along with click-to-place furniture in build mode.[/p][/*][*][p]The Escape key has been remapped to now close UI and pause the game if no UI is open.[/p][/*][*][p]Ducks have been added to the game world![/p][/*][*][p]Your cafe name now appears on the front sign of the building.[/p][/*][*][p]Time will now pause when the following UI elements are open: the calendar, all storage chests, boardgame panel, menu panel, and questboard panel.[/p][/*][*][p]Lower wall colliders have been removed to avoid accidental collision with the player and to help with navigation.[/p][/*][*][p]UI exit and tutorial info buttons have been moved to the top left of UI panels to avoid overlap with the HUD.[/p][/*][*][p]The tutorial info box has been repositioned to the centre of UI panels when opened.[/p][/*][*][p]Three new music tracks have been added to enrich the atmosphere.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]New Decor and Furniture[/b][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]The Enchanted furniture and decor sets are now available from Eccentric Essentials.[/p][/*][*][p]The Mocha books.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Balancing[/b][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Water is now free for all customers to reduce excessive recipe profits.[/p][/*][*][p]Combo and pair multipliers on recipes have full.[/p][/*][*][p]The floating item bug has been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]A bug causing duplicate menu items has been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Unlocked boardgames and recipes no longer carry over between save files.[/p][/*][*][p]The quest board generator now refreshes quests daily with proper randomisation.[/p][/*][*][p]Boardgame usage no longer incorrectly increments at the end of the day.[/p][/*][*][p]Boardgames are now used once per customer, rather than twice.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you for your continued feedback - your reports are helping to shape a stronger experience notes.title: Dragons Brew Alpha 0.1.1.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]Features & Changes[/b]

[list]
[*] The yellow colour grading of the day/night cycle has been toned down for a more natural look.
[*] Reading the intro letter now pauses the game.
[*] Teleportation now locks the player to prevent potential glitches.
[*] Seeds are now stackable for improved inventory management.
[*] Seed tooltips now display the seed type, and seed selling is locked to their appropriate season for better clarity.
[*] The interact button (spacebar) now advances dialogue during the intro scene.
[*] Board games have been removed from the Harbor Market shop.
[*] An Essentials category has been added to the Harbor Market shop for core items.
[*] Appliances now display a "recipe ready" indicator.
[*] Doors now show an interaction clue above the player when in range.
[*] The cafe will now automatically close when the player leaves.
[*] Seated customers will no longer place orders if the player has left the cafe.
[*] Keybindings have been expanded to include an new "Escape" key. Pause has now been rebound to "P", item use and placement to "E", remove to "R", colour selection to "Z", and rotate to "X". You may need to reset your keybindings for changes to take effect.
[*] Pressing "Escape" will now exit any open UI.
[*] "Escape" or right-click will now exit Build Mode and Remove Mode.
[*] Customers will now tidy away board games at the end of the day, resetting the tables.
[*] Build Mode now includes a tooltip notification when furniture cannot be placed or removed.
[*] Crops and trees ready for harvesting now display a "ready" indicator.
[*] Quest categories have been renamed to "Main Quest" and "Side Quest" for consistency.
[*] Time progression has been slowed down to 1 in-game minute per real-world second.
[*] The player menu now includes a dedicated quest log.
[*] Quest descriptions have been removed from the quest bar to reduce quest bar scale and improve readability.
[*] Quests now include helpful tips, viewable in the quest log.
[*] Applying changes in the game settings menu now triggers a confirmation notification.
[*] The inventory and item systems have been fully refactored.
[*] Inventory now remembers item placement between sessions.
[*] Customers will no longer request tables within the final 3 in-game hours before closing.
[*] Left-click interactions now work for objects, NPCs, and customers.
[*] Crafting ingredients now show name tooltips.
[*] Furniture placement and removal is now fully supported with left and right mouse buttons in Build and Remove modes.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Quest progress counters now reload correctly.
[*] Mini-quests now randomise properly.
[*] Collider locks at Ivy Estates Shop, Town Clock, lamp posts, and fences have been removed.
[*] The player character now renders correctly when behind trees.
[*] Cash register and bed now respond correctly to the interact button.
[*] The player can no longer teleport out of bounds.
[*] Main menu music loop has been improved.
[*] The "Back to Menu" button now works as expected.
[*] Removed the void area in the right-side garden expansion.
[*] Furniture placement is now possible in the upper garden area.
[*] The next day button is now fully responsive.
[*] Time is now correctly paused at the end of the day.
[*] Customers will now use all available seats at tables, increasing capacity from two to four.
[*] Customer interaction at tables without active orders has been fixed.
[*] Flooring textures in the apartment have been corrected.
[*] House exteriors now save and load properly.
[*] Tables in use can no longer be removed.
[*] Fixed the interaction bug at the till where spamming the input caused issues.
[*] Customers will no longer become stuck at the counter.
[*] Inventory ghosting issues in empty slots have been resolved.
[*] Items can now only be placed in their appropriate slots for boardgames and menu items.
[*] Crafting is now locked when the output slot is full, preventing errors and stacking issues.
[*] The "Unlimited" menu item and general item duplication issues have been fixed.
[*] Storage limits are now properly respected when buying items.
[*] Shopping UI interaction has been improved: press Escape to exit, and use the interact button to continue buying the same item.
[*] Fixed duplicate removal bugs in Build Mode.
[*] Resolved issues where furniture could not be removed properly.
[*] Inventory and quest ghosting glitches when loading a game have been fixed.
[*] Ingredient usage is now fully consistent with recipes.
[*] Unlocked recipes now appear instantly as intended.
[/list]

Thank you for your continued feedback - your reports are helping to shape a stronger experience with every update.
